primary_endpoint: Changes in ALT, AST, and GGT in NAFLD patients according to statin treatment; no primary endpoint was specified.
efficacy_outcome: In interventional studies, ALT decreased by 27.2 U/L (35.41%), AST by 18.82 U/L (31.78%), and GGT by 19.93 U/L (25.57%). Cross-sectional studies found no difference in AST or GGT between statin-treated and untreated patients.
